_comment: Run template for lbnl-b59 (a real office without DCV). Equipment: the four rooftop units (AHU; RTU0N), the 11 CO2 zones (VAV; RTU0N_zone_<z>) and, in the full subset, the 51 underfloor fan terminals (VAV; RTU0N_uft_<z>). dcv_system_verification joins each zone's CO2 to its RTU's measured OA flow through the RTU0N_ name prefix (a heuristic grouping built from the Brick model, so severities are capped at warn); OA flow is masked before 2020-04-10, so OA-flow verdicts come from April-December 2020; since 0.93 the rule judges the earlier months (August 2019 - March 2020, where the zone CO2 exists) on the OA damper position instead, and both periods read 'not judged -- demand never varied' (zone CO2 stays within ~150 ppm of outdoor). oa_floor_cfm 750 is the 62.1 area component Ra*Az = 0.06 cfm/ft2 x 12,513 ft2 -- the two 2,325 m2 office floors split evenly over the four RTUs, an ASSUMPTION because per-RTU areas are not published (the descriptor's 5,000 cfm is the RTU design minimum OA, not a 62.1 floor). The building has no economizer command point and a mild climate, so the rule infers the economizer from OAT and is expected to decline ('not judged') rather than call DCV functioning -- the specificity lesson. unmet_setpoint_hours runs on the terminals of the full subset. reheat_capacity_shortfall (0.93, #44) runs on them too: the terminals with a heating setpoint and a reheat valve (35 of the 51), judged on the default weekday 07-18 schedule. Zone 051 (RTU01) sits more than 1.5 F below its 72 F heating setpoint with its valve at 90% or more in 35.8% of occupied hours (1,586 h over the three years, median 2.9 F below) -- the fault; nine more read warn at 5-18%, and 25 are ok (nine more have a valve but no heating setpoint and decline). The terminals have no airflow or airflow setpoint, so capacity and airflow are not told apart. co2_ventilation_system (0.93) judges each zone's CO2 with its RTU's economizer state: economizer-mode hours (OAT below the 75 F high limit with the OA damper above its ~10% minimum) are 57-71% of occupied hours and are left out, and the zones still read CO2 near outdoor in nearly every remaining hour -- over-ventilated at the minimum damper, an energy observation for a building whose zone CO2 medians are 419-429 ppm. Not run: the per-zone co2_ventilation (a zone frame carries no damper, so it cannot set economizer hours apart; co2_ventilation_system can), outdoor_air_fraction (no trustworthy unit minimum: the OA/supply flow ratio at the 10% minimum damper is 7-19% and the temperature balance 2-17% by unit, while the design minimum is 25%, and the mixed-air sensors are doubtful -- see the data issues), ventilation_rate_62_1 and ventilation_system_62_1 (per-zone areas and populations are not published; since 0.92 the system VRP runs with stated assumptions, see docs/VENTILATION.md -- they are the user's to confirm, so it is not in the template), and the drift families (no labelled baseline period).
